project.name: RepoChan
project.description: Turn a git repository into a full brand kit — mascot persona, illustrations, stickers, posters and a landing page — via a CLI + agent pipeline.

brand.artStyle: Cinema opening credits — a theatrical black-void screening: constant letterbox frame, classic credit-roll typography (Cinzel + Song serif, wide-tracked small caps), sequential title cards fading in on black, a spotlight sweep across the starring cutout and a lights-up end card.
